title: Chapter 607
text:
[Galaxy Mechanic] was the advanced stage of the Mechanic class. At this level, one could already be called a master. The level limit of this stage was increased by five, and the maximum level was LV 25. According to Han Xiao's memories, most Mechanic players in his previous life had entered Grade A at the 'Galaxy Mechanic' stage.

The new class was called 'Galaxy Mechanic'. The machines it built were even more powerful, and the range of applications gradually transitioned from small situations to galactic wars.

The specific enhancement was the ability to build even more powerful mechanical weapons. For example, Carroll was a Galaxy Mechanic, and the Ship Destroyer Giant Soldier was the blueprint he came up with during his' Galaxy Mechanic 'stage. In the end, it was given to Han Xiao.

From the perspective of the players, this enhancement was reflected in the fusion of blueprints. Class Advancement to 'Galaxy Mechanic' was the prerequisite for higher-level blueprints, and the previous knowledge combinations would unlock more blueprints.

In terms of skills, 'Galaxy Mechanic' would strengthen the specialization he chose in the previous stage, greatly enhancing Han Xiao's Virtual Technology skills. The related skills and talents were strengthened, and he also obtained two new Virtual Technology skills.

[Ultra Fast Virtual Intrusion], as the name suggested, greatly increased the speed of the intrusion, but the price was that the duration of the authorization was shortened.

[Quantum Network Matrix] was a core skill with two effects. The first was that the range of the intrusion would be greatly increased.

Range was an important attribute of Virtual Technology. Face-to-face intrusion and intrusion across an entire Star System were two completely different realms. The quantum network was everywhere, and the level of Virtual Technology determined the extent to which a Mechanic could use the quantum network. Han Xiao's range had greatly increased, but it was still very far away from the terrifying range of a Star System.

Only a Beyond Grade A Mechanic like [Mecha Empire] Manison had such a terrifying range that could cross Star Systems and even Star Clusters.

The second effect of this skill was the Virtual Intrusion version of 'Sputtering'.

For example, if the targets of the intrusion were two independent artificial intelligences, but the two of them were exchanging data and information in real time, then if one of the artificial intelligences was invaded, through the information exchange between the two of them, there would be an indirect intrusion effect. It was similar to how computers spread viruses, equivalent to AE-type Virtual Intrusion attacks, but the detection of an indirect intrusion would be much more difficult.

As for [Master Machinery Affinity], it was needless to say. When it was maxed out, it would give him a 75% increase in Machinery Affinity effect. It was a practical skill.

The last one, [Machinery Theory Summary], was a talent. Like [Machinery Analytical Comprehension], it was one of the core abilities of the Mechanic class. Its effect was to convert Intelligence into Machinery Affinity. The conversion ratio was 30 Intelligence = 2.2% Machinery Affinity.

As the main class continued to level up, the increase in strength from the core attributes of the class became more and more obvious. That was why Han Xiao had put all his points into Intelligence.

"Level 146 …"

Han Xiao thought about it and decided not to continue levelling up. He maxed out his new skills and saved the remaining billions of experience points.

Class Advancement was a watershed, which was why there was an obvious increase in combat power. However, the benefits of leveling up after that would not be high. If he wanted to reach level 160, he would need a huge amount of experience, and the little stock he had on hand was far from enough. He might as well keep it to level up his skills and get more Potential Points. What he lacked the most now was Potential Points, and he only had a single digit left.

With energy flowing through his body like a torrent, Han Xiao could feel the obvious changes in his body. His senses were clearer, and he gently touched the compressed orb. The structure of machinery subconsciously appeared in his mind, and his understanding of machinery became deeper.

After feeling it for a while, Han Xiaoxin left the training room with satisfaction. Only then did he see a message from Herlous inviting him to join the pre-battle meeting to discuss how to deal with the Subterranean Mutants.

Han Xiao could not help but shake his head.
